svg.title: Blagden: heat intelligence for runners in the tropics
svg.desc: A runner on a Manila race morning as the sun rises. Heart rate pulses below, and an estimated core temperature curve climbs past 39.0 C over a synthetic 4-hour run.

g.text: Heat intelligence for runners in the tropics.
Heart rate in. Core temperature, race-morning WBGT and a pace plan out.
